author: More Perfect Union
description:
Data center outrage could flip the House next week.

In Wisconsin, Rebecca Cooke made the fight against data centers central to her campaign while residents worked to block the behemouth projects.

At the same time her Republican opponent is using AI slop and taking money from Elon Musk. And now being on the wrong side of the data center question could cost Rep. Van Orden his job.

Producer: @yuremaperezhinojosa
Editor: @niklaak
Videographer: Joel Van Haren
Supervising Producer: Court Fuller
title: Data Centers got $83 billion in tax breaks. We went to Wisconsin to see the voter revolt.
